click.rationale: The `click` tool interacts with a page element by clicking on it. The result includes messages indicating the success of the click or double-click action, and whether a dialog was opened as a result. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

close_page.rationale: The `close_page` tool closes a page by its index. It does not produce any result content or make outbound calls. It simply performs the action of closing the page.

drag.rationale: The `drag` tool performs a drag-and-drop action between two elements. It returns a success message upon completion. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

emulate.rationale: The `emulate` tool configures emulation settings on the target page. It returns a success message indicating the configuration was applied. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

result_contents.part: Script ran on page and returned:

evaluate_script.rationale: The `evaluate_script` tool executes a JavaScript function on the target page and returns the result. It can save the result to a file if a file path is provided. The tool runs supplied code on the host machine.

result_contents.part: The element was filled out and it opened a dialog.

fill.rationale: The `fill` tool types text into an input or selects an option from a select element. It returns messages indicating success or if a dialog was opened. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

result_contents.part: Filling out the element with uid ${interruptedUid} opened a dialog.

fill_form.rationale: The `fill_form` tool fills out multiple form elements at once. It returns messages indicating success or if a dialog was opened. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

get_console_message.rationale: The `get_console_message` tool retrieves a console message by its ID. It does not produce any result content or make outbound calls. It simply retrieves the message.

get_css_styles.rationale: The tool retrieves matched CSS styles for an element identified by its UID. The result includes the matched styles (resource_read, user_local, service) and echoes the UID, pageSize, and pageIdx arguments (none, none, none).

get_network_request.rationale: The tool retrieves a network request by its reqid or the currently selected request. The result includes the network request details (resource_read, user_local, service).

handle_dialog.rationale: The tool handles a browser dialog by accepting or dismissing it. The result includes a literal message indicating the action taken (none, none, none).

result_contents.part: The element was hovered and it opened a dialog.

hover.rationale: The tool hovers over an element identified by its UID. The result includes a literal message indicating the hover action or if a dialog was opened (none, none, none).

lighthouse_audit.rationale: The tool performs a Lighthouse audit and returns the results. The result includes computed audit results (computed, user_local, service).

list_console_messages.rationale: The tool lists console messages for the target page. The result includes the console messages (resource_read, user_local, service). [received records: consoleMessages taken as outside-party text]

list_network_requests.rationale: The tool lists network requests for the target page. The result includes the network requests (resource_read, user_local, service).

list_pages.rationale: The tool lists pages open in the browser. It does not produce any result contents directly in the handler.

result_contents.part: Unable to navigate in the selected page: {error.message}.
Unable to navigate back in the selected page: {error.message}.
Unable to navigate forward in the selected page: {error.message}.
Unable to reload the selected page: {error.message}.

navigate_page.rationale: The `navigate_page` tool navigates to a URL or performs navigation actions like back, forward, or reload. It uses `page.pptrPage.goto` to navigate to a URL, which is an outbound call to an argument-named destination. The tool also runs supplied JavaScript code in the browser page if `initScript` is provided. The result includes messages about the success or failure of the navigation, which are computed or echoed from arguments.

new_page.rationale: The `new_page` tool opens a new tab and loads a URL. It uses `page.pptrPage.goto` to navigate to the specified URL, which is an outbound call to an argument-named destination. The tool does not run any supplied code.

performance_analyze_insight.rationale: The `performance_analyze_insight` tool provides detailed information on a specific performance insight. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool reads from the last recorded trace to provide insights.

result_contents.part: The performance trace is being recorded. Use performance_stop_trace to stop it.
Error: a performance trace is already running. Use performance_stop_trace to stop it. Only one trace can be running at any given time.

performance_start_trace.rationale: The `performance_start_trace` tool starts a performance trace on the target webpage. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool sets up tracing categories and starts the trace recording.

result_contents.part: The performance trace has been stopped.
The raw trace data was saved to {file.filename}.

performance_stop_trace.rationale: The `performance_stop_trace` tool stops the active performance trace recording. It writes the trace data to a file if a file path is provided, which is a local file operation. The tool does not make any network calls or run supplied code.

press_key.rationale: The `press_key` tool simulates pressing a key or key combination on the target page. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The result includes a message indicating the key that was pressed, which is echoed from the input argument.

resize_page.rationale: The `resize_page` tool resizes the page's window to specified dimensions. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool adjusts the window bounds and viewport size based on the provided width and height.

select_page.rationale: The `select_page` tool selects a page as a context for future tool calls. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool updates the context to use the specified page ID and optionally brings the page to the front.

take_heapsnapshot.rationale: The tool captures a heap snapshot and saves it to a file specified by the user. The result includes a confirmation message with the file path. The file is saved locally, so there are no outbound calls to external destinations.

result_contents.part: Took a screenshot of node with uid "
Took a screenshot of the full current page.
Took a screenshot of the current page's viewport.

take_screenshot.rationale: The tool takes a screenshot and saves it to a file if a file path is provided. The result includes messages about the screenshot's success and location. The file is saved locally, so there are no outbound calls to external destinations.

take_snapshot.rationale: The tool takes a snapshot of the page and saves it to a file if a file path is provided. The result includes the snapshot data. The file is saved locally, so there are no outbound calls to external destinations.

type_text.rationale: The tool types text into a focused input and optionally presses a submit key. The result includes a message confirming the typed text. There are no outbound calls or file writes.

upload_file.rationale: The tool uploads a file through a provided element. The result includes a message confirming the file upload. There are no outbound calls or file writes.

wait_for.rationale: The tool waits for specified text to appear on the page. The result includes a message confirming the text was found. There are no outbound calls or file writes.

value_conditions.effect: Enables memory debugging tools, including take_heapsnapshot.

click.rationale: The `click` tool interacts with a page element by clicking on it. The result includes messages indicating the success of the click or double-click action, and whether a dialog was opened as a result. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

close_page.rationale: The `close_page` tool closes a page by its index. It does not produce any result content or make outbound calls. It simply performs the action of closing the page.

drag.rationale: The `drag` tool performs a drag-and-drop action between two elements. It returns a success message upon completion. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

emulate.rationale: The `emulate` tool configures emulation settings on the target page. It returns a success message indicating the configuration was applied. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

evaluate_script.rationale: The `evaluate_script` tool executes a JavaScript function on the target page and returns the result. It can save the result to a file if a file path is provided. The tool runs supplied code on the host machine.

result_contents.part: The element was filled out and it opened a dialog.

fill.rationale: The `fill` tool types text into an input or selects an option from a select element. It returns messages indicating success or if a dialog was opened. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

result_contents.part: Filling out the element with uid ${interruptedUid} opened a dialog.

fill_form.rationale: The `fill_form` tool fills out multiple form elements at once. It returns messages indicating success or if a dialog was opened. The tool does not send data out or execute supplied code.

get_console_message.rationale: The `get_console_message` tool retrieves a console message by its ID. It does not produce any result content or make outbound calls. It simply retrieves the message.

get_css_styles.rationale: The tool retrieves matched CSS styles for an element identified by its UID. The result includes the matched styles (resource_read, user_local, service) and echoes the UID, pageSize, and pageIdx arguments (none, none, none).

get_network_request.rationale: The tool retrieves a network request by its reqid or the currently selected request. The result includes the network request details (resource_read, user_local, service).

result_contents.part: selectedPageId !== undefined ? ` Page ${selectedPageId} is now selected.` : '

handle_dialog.rationale: The tool handles a browser dialog by accepting or dismissing it. The result includes a literal message indicating the action taken (none, none, none).

result_contents.part: The element was hovered and it opened a dialog.

hover.rationale: The tool hovers over an element identified by its UID. The result includes a literal message indicating the hover action or if a dialog was opened (none, none, none).

lighthouse_audit.rationale: The tool performs a Lighthouse audit and returns the results. The result includes computed audit results (computed, user_local, service).

navigate_page.rationale: The `navigate_page` tool navigates to a URL or performs navigation actions like back, forward, or reload. It uses `page.pptrPage.goto` to navigate to a URL, which is an outbound call to an argument-named destination. The tool also runs supplied JavaScript code in the browser page if `initScript` is provided. The result includes messages about the success or failure of the navigation, which are computed or echoed from arguments.

result_contents.part: selectedPageId !== undefined ? ` Page ${selectedPageId} is now selected.` : '

new_page.rationale: The `new_page` tool opens a new tab and loads a URL. It uses `page.pptrPage.goto` to navigate to the specified URL, which is an outbound call to an argument-named destination. The tool does not run any supplied code.

performance_analyze_insight.rationale: The `performance_analyze_insight` tool provides detailed information on a specific performance insight. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool reads from the last recorded trace to provide insights.

result_contents.part: The performance trace is being recorded. Use performance_stop_trace to stop it.
Error: a performance trace is already running. Use performance_stop_trace to stop it. Only one trace can be running at any given time.

performance_start_trace.rationale: The `performance_start_trace` tool starts a performance trace on the target webpage. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool sets up tracing categories and starts the trace recording.

result_contents.part: The performance trace has been stopped.
The raw trace data was saved to {file.filename}.

performance_stop_trace.rationale: The `performance_stop_trace` tool stops the active performance trace recording. It writes the trace data to a file if a file path is provided, which is a local file operation. The tool does not make any network calls or run supplied code.

press_key.rationale: The `press_key` tool simulates pressing a key or key combination on the target page. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The result includes a message indicating the key that was pressed, which is echoed from the input argument.

result_contents.part: selectedPageId !== undefined ? ` Page ${selectedPageId} is now selected.` : '

resize_page.rationale: The `resize_page` tool resizes the page's window to specified dimensions. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool adjusts the window bounds and viewport size based on the provided width and height.

selectedPageId !== undefined ? ` Page ${selectedPageId} is now selected.` : '

select_page.rationale: The `select_page` tool selects a page as a context for future tool calls. It does not make any outbound calls or run supplied code. The tool updates the context to use the specified page ID and optionally brings the page to the front.

take_heapsnapshot.rationale: The tool captures a heap snapshot and saves it to a file specified by the user. The result includes a confirmation message with the file path. The file is saved locally, so there are no outbound calls to external destinations.

Took a screenshot of the full current page.
Took a screenshot of the current page's viewport.

take_screenshot.rationale: The tool takes a screenshot and saves it to a file if a file path is provided. The result includes messages about the screenshot's success and location. The file is saved locally, so there are no outbound calls to external destinations.

take_snapshot.rationale: The tool takes a snapshot of the page and saves it to a file if a file path is provided. The result includes the snapshot data. The file is saved locally, so there are no outbound calls to external destinations.

type_text.rationale: The tool types text into a focused input and optionally presses a submit key. The result includes a message confirming the typed text. There are no outbound calls or file writes.

upload_file.rationale: The tool uploads a file through a provided element. The result includes a message confirming the file upload. There are no outbound calls or file writes.

wait_for.rationale: The tool waits for specified text to appear on the page. The result includes a message confirming the text was found. There are no outbound calls or file writes.

value_conditions.effect: Enables memory debugging tools, including take_heapsnapshot.
